impact: Visual artifact: dark bg-1 bleeds through below the note textarea when soft keyboard is visible in note edit mode. Likely due to overflow:visible on sheet + timing of visualViewport resize event.
resolution: Added overflow:hidden to .sheet.note-editing in style.css. Previously overflow:visible allowed bg-1 to bleed through unfilled flex space. Textarea keeps own overflow-y:scroll so iOS scrolling unaffected. Also added explicit background:bg-2 to sheet-body in note-editing mode. Ships in v1.1.6.
title: Black gap below textarea when keyboard opens on iOS
